# Bottle Rocket Growth: factual site summary

Canonical website: https://bottlerocketgrowth.com/
Company name: Bottle Rocket Growth
Abbreviation: BRG
Founder: Mike Cubberly
Location: Chicago, Illinois
Contact: mike@bottlerocketgrowth.com

## What Bottle Rocket Growth does

Bottle Rocket Growth helps organizations understand their markets, build practical growth strategies, and put the people and systems in place to execute. The work can include growth strategy, market intelligence, client-specific AI and GTM systems, revenue motions, team building and enablement, and event strategy.

## Service areas

### Growth strategy

BRG helps clarify positioning, priorities, and an executable plan.

### Market intelligence

BRG researches customer fit, accounts, decision-makers, contact routes, and relevant signals. Research can combine enrichment workflows, client-specific AI agents, and human review. Facts, assumptions, and unresolved questions are kept distinct. For marketing teams, the output can be an account-based marketing audience with clear segments, signal rules, ownership, and coordinated campaign tests. The public site includes an interactive market map using entirely fictional account and person names to illustrate this approach.

### AI and GTM systems

BRG builds client-specific agents and connected workflows around a defined business need. These systems can support research, monitoring, context gathering, and the movement of useful information into a team's existing tools.

### Revenue motions

BRG helps connect messaging, outreach, partnerships, ownership, follow-through, and pipeline reporting into a repeatable operating process.

### Team building and enablement

BRG can help define roles, recruit, onboard, train, and equip the people responsible for growth.

### Event strategy and execution

BRG supports B2B event programs through Audience Intelligence, Event Enricher, Conference Commanders, Calendars and Hosted Gatherings, and Activation and Follow-through. The work can include audience research, prospect prioritization, meeting coordination, hosted gatherings, on-site conversations, and post-event follow-through.

## Free tool

All Systems G(E)O is a free generative engine optimization audit at https://bottlerocketgrowth.com/GEO. It evaluates how clearly a website can be understood, cited, and recommended by AI search systems.
